title: precheck splits a goal's asserted values joined by a bare and, so a second assertion no check reads is a missing check
goal: precheck SP lists as separate goal clauses two asserted values a goal joins with a bare ' and ' (not only '; ' and ', and '), or warns that one repro reads only one of them; found in the SP-7ff7c5ui review: BG-2rh4u36u's goal asserted terms('26100') and terms('S-1-5-32-544'), its only repro read the first, and the second was proved by a hand run
